purpose: empirical validation of the proposed capability-aware skip mechanism in the isolated BUILD_TESTING=ON build tree (frozen patch NOT modified; demonstration via generated CTestTestfile.cmake edits only)

finding_F_C2_3.title: upstream MIOPEN_TEST_GDB default On discards test exit codes on Linux

evidence.wrapper_generated: test/test_test_hiprtc_selfcontained.cmake wraps the binary with execute_process + message(FATAL_ERROR "Test failed") on any nonzero RESULT
evidence.consequence: exit 4 (INCONCLUSIVE) collapses to generic failure; SKIP_RETURN_CODE alone can never match while registered through add_test_command on Linux
